CSD_registration.description: Central Supplier Database (CSD) registration at secure.csd.gov.za is mandatory for ALL government tenders in South Africa. Companies must achieve 'Active' and 'Verified' status. The CSD MAAA report must be submitted with every bid. Registration verifies tax compliance, B-BBEE status, CIDB grading, and bank account details.

CIDB_grading.applicable_to_IT: CIDB grading (Construction Industry Development Board) is primarily required for construction and civil works contracts. For pure IT services (software development, application design, connectivity), CIDB grading is generally NOT required. However, some government departments include CIDB registration as a general compliance item.
CIDB_grading.note: If Veramani bids on tenders that include any site-based infrastructure works (e.g., connectivity cabling at a mine), a CIDB grade may be required. Pure software/digital projects typically only need CSD + tax compliance + B-BBEE.

BBBEE_requirements.description: B-BBEE compliance is scored on the 90/10 or 80/20 preferential procurement formula. For contracts above R30m, the 90/10 split applies (90 points for price, 10 for B-BBEE). Level 1â€“4 B-BBEE certification strengthens bid scoring materially.
BBBEE_requirements.recommendation: A B-BBEE Level 1 or 2 EME/QSE affidavit (if annual turnover is below R10m and R50m respectively) can be self-certified and is a strong competitive advantage.

compliance_requirements.tax_compliance: Valid SARS Tax Clearance PIN (issued via eFiling) is mandatory for all government bids.
